title: Greetings
description: Open and close a conversation without sounding like a textbook.

questions.sentence: Namaste, tapai sanchai hunuhuncha?
options: Namaste, ma sanchai chu.
Mero naam Ram ho.
Ma Pokhara ma baschu.
questions.correctAnswer: Namaste, ma sanchai chu.
questions.translatedSentence: Hello, I am well.

questions.sentence: Namaste, mero naam Sita ho.
options: Hello, my name is Sita.
Hello, this is my house.
Hello, my friend is Sita.
questions.correctAnswer: Hello, my name is Sita.

questions.sentence: Timi sanchai chau?
options: Ha, ma thik chu.
Ha, chiya tato cha.
Ha, ghar najik cha.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, ma thik chu.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am fine.

questions.sentence: Timro naam ke ho?
options: What is your name?
Where is your house?
Who is your friend?
questions.correctAnswer: What is your name?

questions.sentence: Aja ke cha?
options: Sabai thik cha.
Ghar tadha cha.
Chiya mitho cha.
questions.correctAnswer: Sabai thik cha.
questions.translatedSentence: Everything is fine.

questions.sentence: Ma Kathmandu ma baschu.
options: I live in Kathmandu.
I am going to Kathmandu.
I am from Kathmandu.
questions.correctAnswer: I live in Kathmandu.

questions.sentence: Tapailai kasto cha?
options: Malai sanchai cha, dhanyabad.
Malai bato thaha chaina.
Malai chiya man parcha.
questions.correctAnswer: Malai sanchai cha, dhanyabad.
questions.translatedSentence: I am doing fine, thank you.

questions.sentence: Ma sanchai chu, dhanyabad.
options: I am well, thank you.
I am busy, thank you.
I am here, thank you.
questions.correctAnswer: I am well, thank you.

questions.sentence: Ma sanchai chu, tapai ni?
options: Ma pani sanchai chu.
Ma bholi aauchu.
Ma yaha basdina.
questions.correctAnswer: Ma pani sanchai chu.
questions.translatedSentence: I am well too.

questions.sentence: Subha prabhat, tapai aja sabera uthnu bhayo?
options: Ho, ma panch baje uthe.
Ho, ma raati dhilo sute.
Hoina, malai chiya man pardaina.
questions.correctAnswer: Ho, ma panch baje uthe.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I got up at five o'clock.

questions.sentence: Subha prabhat, tapaiko din ramro hos.
options: Good morning, have a nice day.
Good morning, have a safe trip.
Good evening, have a nice day.
questions.correctAnswer: Good morning, have a nice day.

questions.sentence: Bhitra aaunuhos, hamro gharma swagat cha.
options: Dhanyabad, ghar dherai ramro cha.
Maaf garnuhos, malai bato thaha bhayena.
Hoina, ma yaha basdina.
questions.correctAnswer: Dhanyabad, ghar dherai ramro cha.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you, your home is very nice.

questions.sentence: Beluka hami sangai chiya khanchau.
options: In the evening we drink tea together.
In the evening we eat dinner together.
In the morning we drink tea together.
questions.correctAnswer: In the evening we drink tea together.

questions.sentence: Chiya khanuhuncha ki paani?
options: Malai chiya chahiyo, dhanyabad.
Ma bihana matra chiya khanchu.
Maaf garnuhos, malai bhok lageko chaina.
questions.correctAnswer: Malai chiya chahiyo, dhanyabad.
questions.translatedSentence: I would like tea, thank you.

questions.sentence: Aja raati dherai chiso cha, ramro sanga sutnuhos.
options: It is very cold tonight, so sleep well.
It is very hot tonight, so sleep well.
It is very cold tonight, so come home early.
questions.correctAnswer: It is very cold tonight, so sleep well.

questions.sentence: Ma aba sutna jaanchu, subha ratri.
options: Subha ratri, ramro sanga sutnus.
Subha prabhat, chiya khanuhos.
Namaste, ma pani jaadai chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Subha ratri, ramro sanga sutnus.
questions.translatedSentence: Good night, sleep well.

questions.sentence: Subha ratri, bholi bihana bhetaula.
options: Good night, see you tomorrow morning.
Good night, see you next week.
Good evening, see you tomorrow morning.
questions.correctAnswer: Good night, see you tomorrow morning.

questions.sentence: Subha ratri, mitho sapana dekhnus.
options: Dhanyabad, tapailai pani subha ratri.
Dhanyabad, ma bihana sabera uthchu.
Hunchha, ma chiya banauchu.
questions.correctAnswer: Dhanyabad, tapailai pani subha ratri.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you, good night to you too.

questions.sentence: Dherai dhanyabad, tapaile ramro maddat garnu bhayo.
options: Kehi chaina, malai khusi lagyo.
Maaf garnuhos, malai thaha chaina.
Hunchha, ma bholi aauchu.
questions.correctAnswer: Kehi chaina, malai khusi lagyo.
questions.translatedSentence: It was nothing, I was glad to help.

questions.sentence: Tapaile garnu bhayeko maddat ko lagi dherai dhanyabad.
options: Thank you very much for the help you gave me.
Thank you very much for coming all the way here.
I am sorry for all the trouble I gave you.
questions.correctAnswer: Thank you very much for the help you gave me.

questions.sentence: Maaf garnuhos, ma dhilo aaye.
options: Kehi chaina, bhitra aaunuhos.
Dhanyabad, ma pani jaanchu.
Hoina, bato dherai ramro cha.
questions.correctAnswer: Kehi chaina, bhitra aaunuhos.
questions.translatedSentence: No problem, please come in.

questions.sentence: Maaf garnuhos, malai nepali ali ali matra aaucha.
options: Sorry, I only speak a little Nepali.
Sorry, I do not speak Nepali at all.
Sorry, I am learning Nepali right now.
questions.correctAnswer: Sorry, I only speak a little Nepali.

questions.sentence: Maaf garnuhos, yo micro bus Thamel jaancha?
options: Jaancha, tara ali dhilo pugcha.
Malai bus ko naam thaha cha.
Ho, ma Thamel ma baschu.
questions.correctAnswer: Jaancha, tara ali dhilo pugcha.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes it does, but it gets there a bit late.

questions.sentence: Kripaya ali bistarai bolnuhos, malai bujhna garho cha.
options: Please speak a little slowly, it is hard for me to understand.
Please speak a little louder, I cannot hear you at all.
Please say that again, I did not hear the last word.
questions.correctAnswer: Please speak a little slowly, it is hard for me to understand.

questions.sentence: Kripaya malai ek gilas paani dinuhos.
options: Hunchha, aile lyauchu.
Hunchha, chiya pani mitho cha.
Maaf garnuhos, malai paani man pardaina.
questions.correctAnswer: Hunchha, aile lyauchu.
questions.translatedSentence: Sure, I will bring it right now.

questions.sentence: Dhanyabad bhannu pardaina, yo ta mero kaam nai ho.
options: You do not have to thank me, this is my job after all.
You do not have to pay me, this is my house after all.
Do not thank me, because I really did nothing at all.
questions.correctAnswer: You do not have to thank me, this is my job after all.

questions.sentence: Malai maaf garnuhos, maile tapaiko naam birse.
options: Kehi chaina, mero naam Bikash ho.
Dhanyabad, tapaiko naam ramro cha.
Hoina, ma tapailai chindina.
questions.correctAnswer: Kehi chaina, mero naam Bikash ho.
questions.translatedSentence: No problem, my name is Bikash.

questions.sentence: La ta, ma aba jaanchu.
options: Hunchha, pheri bhetaula.
Hunchha, bhitra aaunuhos.
Dhanyabad, ma sanchai chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Hunchha, pheri bhetaula.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, see you again.

questions.sentence: Ma aba jaanchu, pheri bhetaula.
options: I am leaving now, see you again.
I am coming now, see you again.
I am leaving now, see you tomorrow.
questions.correctAnswer: I am leaving now, see you again.

questions.sentence: Bholi bihana office ma bhetaula, hunchha?
options: Hunchha, ma sabera aauchu.
Hunchha, ma aile ghar ma chu.
Hoina, malai office thaha chaina.
questions.correctAnswer: Hunchha, ma sabera aauchu.
questions.translatedSentence: Sure, I will come early.

questions.sentence: Bhetera dherai khusi lagyo, aram garnus.
options: It was very nice to meet you, take care.
It was very nice to meet you, come again.
I am very happy today, so take care.
questions.correctAnswer: It was very nice to meet you, take care.

questions.sentence: Ramro sanga jaanus, bato ma dhyan dinus.
options: Dhanyabad, ma pugera phone garchu.
Dhanyabad, ma yaha nai baschu.
Hunchha, ma bihana sabera sutchu.
questions.correctAnswer: Dhanyabad, ma pugera phone garchu.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you, I will call once I get there.

questions.sentence: Beluka pharkane bela ma malai phone garnus.
options: Call me when you are heading back in the evening.
Call me once you have reached home in the evening.
Come and see me before you leave in the evening.
questions.correctAnswer: Call me when you are heading back in the evening.

questions.sentence: Tapai kahile pharkanu huncha?
options: Ma arko hapta pharkanchu.
Ma Pokhara ma basdina.
Ma bihana chiya khanchu.
questions.correctAnswer: Ma arko hapta pharkanchu.
questions.translatedSentence: I will come back next week.

questions.sentence: Ma dui hapta pachi Kathmandu pharkanchu.
options: I will come back to Kathmandu in two weeks.
I came back to Kathmandu two weeks ago.
I will be leaving Kathmandu in two weeks.
questions.correctAnswer: I will come back to Kathmandu in two weeks.

questions.sentence: Ghar ma sabailai namaste bhanidinus.
options: Hunchha, ma bhanidinchu.
Hunchha, ma bhitra aauchu.
Maaf garnuhos, malai ghar thaha chaina.
questions.correctAnswer: Hunchha, ma bhanidinchu.
questions.translatedSentence: Sure, I will pass it on to them.

questions.sentence: Maaf garnuhos hajur, ma euta kura sodhna sakchu?
options: Hunchha, sodhnuhos na.
Hoina, malai kehi thaha chaina.
Dhanyabad, ma aile jaandai chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Hunchha, sodhnuhos na.
questions.translatedSentence: Of course, please go ahead and ask.

questions.sentence: Thulo manche sanga kura garda hajur bhannu parcha.
options: When you talk to an elder you should say hajur.
When you talk to a child you should say hajur.
When you talk to an elder you should stand up.
questions.correctAnswer: When you talk to an elder you should say hajur.

questions.sentence: Didi, yo micro bus Pokhara jaancha ki jaadaina?
options: Jaadaina, tapaile arko bus samatnu parcha.
Jaancha, tara malai Pokhara thaha chaina.
Malai yo bus ko naam matra thaha cha.
questions.correctAnswer: Jaadaina, tapaile arko bus samatnu parcha.
questions.translatedSentence: No it does not, you will have to catch another bus.

questions.sentence: Tapaile malai chinnu hunna, tara ma tapailai maddat garna sakchu.
options: You do not know me, but I can still help you.
I do not know you, but I can still help you.
You do not know me, so I cannot help you.
questions.correctAnswer: You do not know me, but I can still help you.

questions.sentence: Hajurbua sanga kura garda timi bhannu hundaina.
options: Thaha paye, ma aba tapai nai bhanchu.
Thaha chaina, ma timi nai bhanchu.
Hunchha, ma hajurbua lai chindina.
questions.correctAnswer: Thaha paye, ma aba tapai nai bhanchu.
questions.translatedSentence: I see, from now on I will say tapai.

questions.sentence: Umer le thulo manche lai naam le bolaunu ramro maanidaina.
options: It is not considered polite to call an older person by name.
It is not considered polite to ask an older person their age.
It is considered polite to call an older person by name.
questions.correctAnswer: It is not considered polite to call an older person by name.

questions.sentence: Nani, timi kaha bata aayeko?
options: Ma America bata aayeko hu, hajurbua.
Ma America jaadai chu, timi ni?
Malai thaha chaina, timro ghar kaha ho?
questions.correctAnswer: Ma America bata aayeko hu, hajurbua.
questions.translatedSentence: I have come from America, grandfather.

questions.sentence: Kripaya jutta bahira nikalera matra bhitra pasnuhos.
options: Please take your shoes off outside before you come in.
Please leave your bag outside before you come in.
Please put your shoes on before you step outside.
questions.correctAnswer: Please take your shoes off outside before you come in.

questions.sentence: Dai, yo momo ko kati parcha?
options: Ek plate ko ek saya rupaiya parcha.
Momo dherai mitho cha, khanuhos na.
Malai momo man pardaina, maaf garnuhos.
questions.correctAnswer: Ek plate ko ek saya rupaiya parcha.
questions.translatedSentence: One plate costs a hundred rupees.

questions.sentence: Are, dherai dinpachi bhetiyo, tapai kaha haraunu bhayo?
options: Ma teen mahina Pokhara ma thiye, tesaile bhet bhayena.
Ma yaha nai chu, tara malai tapai thaha chaina.
Ma bholi Pokhara jaandai chu, tapai pani aaunus.
questions.correctAnswer: Ma teen mahina Pokhara ma thiye, tesaile bhet bhayena.
questions.translatedSentence: I was in Pokhara for three months, so we never ran into each other.

questions.sentence: Dherai dinpachi bhetiyo, tapai ta ekdam patlo hunu bhayecha.
options: It has been ages since we met, and you have got really thin.
It has been ages since we met, and you look really happy.
We met only a few days ago, but you looked very tired.
questions.correctAnswer: It has been ages since we met, and you have got really thin.

questions.sentence: Timro parivar sanchai cha? Dherai bhayo timro khabar nai chaina.
options: Sabai sanchai chan, ma nai byasta thiye.
Sabai sanchai chan, tara ma timilai chindina.
Malai khabar thaha chaina, maaf garnuhos.
questions.correctAnswer: Sabai sanchai chan, ma nai byasta thiye.
questions.translatedSentence: Everyone is fine, I was just the one who was busy.

questions.sentence: Ma pahile Kathmandu ma basthe, tara aile Pokhara sarisake.
options: I used to live in Kathmandu, but I have moved to Pokhara now.
I used to live in Pokhara, but I have moved to Kathmandu now.
I live in Kathmandu now, but I want to move to Pokhara.
questions.correctAnswer: I used to live in Kathmandu, but I have moved to Pokhara now.

questions.sentence: Tapai aajakal ke garnu huncha?
options: Ma Thamel ma euta pasal chalauchu, tesaile ali byasta chu.
Ma hijo Thamel gaye, tyo din dherai ramro thiyo.
Ma Thamel chindina, tara tyaha jaana chahanchu.
questions.correctAnswer: Ma Thamel ma euta pasal chalauchu, tesaile ali byasta chu.
questions.translatedSentence: I run a little shop in Thamel, so I am fairly busy.

questions.sentence: Fursad bhayo bhane bholi chiya khana aaunus, ghar najik nai cha.
options: If you have time, come for tea tomorrow; my place is close by.
If you have time, come for dinner tomorrow; my place is close by.
When you are free, call me tomorrow because my place is far.
questions.correctAnswer: If you have time, come for tea tomorrow; my place is close by.

questions.sentence: Bhet nai nabhayeko dherai bhayo, bhok lagyo bhane momo khana jaam?
options: Jaam na, tara pahile ma chiya khanchu.
Ho, momo Kathmandu ma dherai mitho huncha.
Malai bhok lageko chaina bhane ma khanchu.
questions.correctAnswer: Jaam na, tara pahile ma chiya khanchu.
questions.translatedSentence: Let's go, but first I want to have some tea.

questions.sentence: Himalaya trek ma jane bichar cha, tara aile paisa pugdaina.
options: I am thinking of going on a Himalaya trek, but I cannot afford it yet.
I went on a Himalaya trek, but it cost more money than I had.
I want to go on a Himalaya trek because I have saved enough money.
questions.correctAnswer: I am thinking of going on a Himalaya trek, but I cannot afford it yet.

questions.sentence: Tapai Nepal ma basnu bhayeko kati barsa bhayo?
options: Dui barsa bhayo, tara ma aile pani nepali sikdai chu.
Dui barsa aghi ma America pharkeko thiye.
Ma Nepal ma basdina, ma bholi matra aauchu.
questions.correctAnswer: Dui barsa bhayo, tara ma aile pani nepali sikdai chu.
questions.translatedSentence: It has been two years, and I am still learning Nepali.
